comments.mergedPostDetails:
Before the beta, when timing out, clicking on "retry" will simply reloads the current instance. 

Now, it will often send you in your home. So rejoining your friends takes additional steps and an additional loading screen.

Also the timing out error message is often out of the view (this is on desktop, not vr) and is triggered twice on my end.

I know it's currently not possible for VRChat to dynamically recover a connection drop, but this is a regression compared to the live version. I do have a lot of timing out, the other day 16 timing out before I was able to play, so this is really frustrating. Please improve the new timing out behavior.

Now (2023.05.01) with many UDON programs in the world, it takes a very long time to deploy data to join the world.This causes a timeout error.

Previously, the time to this timeout was set for a long time, so even a CPU with a slightly lower performance could join the world, but now I can't join the world.This happens in any world where UDON is used a lot, but as an example, Pandora - LastEpisode, which I created, is a problem because the player I was trying to capture cannot join the world.

And players who couldn't join have been sent to HOME World or a world with letters written on a white wall.

Does the time setting for this timeout error roll back every time something is updated on the server?As far as I know, this is the third time this is the same defect, but if this is the specification of VRChat, I think I have to accept it.

If it is okay to increase the time until this timeout error, I would like to ask you to set it up again.That way, many players will be temporarily happy to avoid the need to buy high-performance CPUs.

サーバーの何か更新が行われる度にこのタイムアウトエラーまでの時間の設定がロールバックしていませんか？私が知る限りこれで3回目の同じ不具合ですが、これがVRChatの仕様だということであれば、私は受け止めなければならないと考えています。

もしこのタイムアウトエラーまでの時間をもっと長くしても大丈夫なのであれば、再びその設定をお願いしたいです。そうすることで多くのプレイヤーが高性能なCPUを買う必要を免れ、一時的に幸せになれることでしょう。

comments.mergedPostDetails:
When you getting disconnect from vrchat you get a dialog with two buttons. 

Then you click the retry button and the dialog closes and same window reappears. 

And pressing the retry button again will take you to your home world.
comments.mergedPostTitle: [1304] Retry button take you to home instead of current instance.
comments.value: Happens on first press for me.

There is a workaround to avoid to be sent in your home. While timing out, open your quick menu and rejoin the instance. After you finished "Timing out" click on retry and it will reload the current instance.

@{5b99d19aee038460c535199e|full_name}: I have the same problem, my world relies on a lot of Udon data (around 50mb) and users (especially Quest users) are having issues joining, which is a problem itself, but they're also now being sent home instead of re-trying until it works. Ideally, worlds wouldn't fail to load from Udon data being loaded.
We've got a fix for this internally which should release with the next release cycle!
